name: Sparse Voxel Octree Node Structure
definition: Defines the memory layout and connectivity of a node in a sparse voxel octree, storing spatial position, size, parent/child links, leaf status, and 6 directional neighbor links.
summary: The Sparse Voxel Octree Node Structure defines memory layout and state management for sparse voxel octrees, enabling efficient volumetric representation by storing only occupied regions and dynamically splitting or merging nodes to reduce memory overhead.
